fixes.en: But the end of the war did not simply mean the arrival of peace.
fixes.why: Mistranslated structure: source says it was not so simple that war's end equalled peace; current English compares the end of the war with the arrival of peace.

fixes.en: It began with postwar reconstruction, then the suppression of some of the Zentradi remnants,
fixes.why: Dropped qualifier: source says a portion of the Zentradi remnants, not all of them.

fixes.en: Humanity and the Vajra: utterly different forms of life that had never been able to get along.
fixes.why: Tense/meaning: source is past ('had never been compatible'); timeless 'never able to coexist' contradicts row 174, where they coexist.
